audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Camille five of seven stages including levels 1-3, while the whys text on those same rows said Camille has no waveclear and eats chip for every last-hit. diff also read EVEN against a tone, diffRating and final line that all said hard.
audit.why: Precision Protocol is 325 range and Camille has no waveclear pre-6; Heimerdinger genuinely owns levels 1-2. The packet chart and the mirror both read Heimerdinger early. Win rate is 50%, so a 5-0 chart cannot be right.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Camille / Skill / Camille on both layers, ratings moved with it, diff set to HARD.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and 2-item rows were generic template text naming no ability and no cooldown.
audit.why: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140/115/90 and 475 range — it dashes to you and anchors you to the area, which is the whole reason an immobile Heimerdinger loses the stage. Her 2-item spike is the true-damage recast on Precision Protocol.
audit.corrected: Level 6 keyed to the 140s R and never sitting forward while it is up; 2 items keyed to Q's true damage cutting through the buildings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X' in six places, its stun called a 'center-stun', turret beams were said to slow, and Adaptive Defenses was never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat, 970) — only the direct hit stuns and the turret's secondary attack is a pass-through beam with no slow. Adaptive Defenses shields Camille against the damage type she was last hit by, so a Heimerdinger burst is exactly what it absorbs. Tactical Sweep's outer cone heals her, and Precision Protocol's recast is true damage that armour does not touch.
audit.corrected: Bleed Adaptive Defenses before committing, save CH-2's direct hit for the Hookshot dash, and keep anti-heal for the Tactical Sweep outer cone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that her combo opens on an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Precision Protocol is an attack reset — the auto wind-up, not the ability cast, is the cue to step back out of the nest.
audit.corrected: Read the auto wind-up rather than the cast when deciding to disengage.

edits.before: Camille has to come to you, and pre-6 she has no waveclear and no real answer to a banked nest. Get a second H-28G turret down by level 2 and freeze on your side — the slowing electron beam means she eats chip for every CS she reaches. Do not waste the CH-3X grenade on poke; it is your only hard CC, and you need its center-stun saved for the instant she commits her E hookshot. If she walks in without E up, beam-slow her and W-rocket her off — she cannot trade into three turrets bare.
edits.after: Camille has to come to you, and pre-6 she has no waveclear and no real answer to a banked nest. Get a second H-28G turret down by level 2 and freeze on your side — the pass-through beam means she eats chip for every CS she reaches. Do not waste the CH-2 grenade on poke; it is your only hard CC, and you need its direct-hit stun saved for the instant she commits Hookshot, which is 16s at rank 1. If she walks in without E up, beam her and W-rocket her off — she cannot trade into three turrets bare.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak: three banked turret charges plus the center-stun make her E-dive suicidal, so bait it. The moment she hookshots in, drop the grenade so the stun catches her center-mass — stunned and beam-slowed, she cannot finish her Q's empowered second hit or land the W outer cone for the heal before the turrets melt her. Then 6 arrives and the math swings: The Hextech Ultimatum rings you off from your nest and isolates you 1v1, exactly what an immobile yordle dreads. Respect her R cooldown — never sit forward when it is up, and keep a turret between you and her wall-dash angle.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your peak: three banked turret charges plus the direct-hit stun make her E-dive suicidal, so bait it. The moment she hookshots in, lob the grenade so the stun catches her directly — stunned, she cannot finish her Q's empowered second hit or land the Tactical Sweep outer cone for the heal before the turrets melt her, and remember Adaptive Defenses shields her against magic after every auto. Then 6 arrives and the math swings: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you off your nest 1v1, exactly what an immobile yordle dreads. Never sit forward while her 140s R is up.

edits.before: This is where Camille pulls ahead. Once she has two items, her empowered Q true damage and W cone cut straight through your turrets, and your low base HP folds the instant she R-isolates you off the nest. You stay relevant only by refusing the side-lane duel: hold chokes where your turret wall and CH-3X can actually fire, and never get caught alone where she can wall you in with no buildings to back you up. Group, drop turrets on objectives, and make her fight into your nest instead of catching you outside it — split off and the R isolation is a free kill for her.
edits.after: This is where Camille pulls ahead. Group, drop turrets on objectives, and make her fight into your nest instead of catching you outside it — split off and the R isolation is a free kill.
